silicon_surface_energy_2.name: Silicon Surface Energy - Level 2
silicon_surface_energy_2.description: Calculate the surface energy of Silicon in the given surface by removing periodic boundary conditions in the given direction and computing the energy difference per unit area between the relaxed bulk and the relaxed slab configuration. Use the reaxff potential. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Return the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²) units.
